title: Genesis–Joshua: promise, presence and settlement
author: Pekka M. A. Pitkänen, following Jacob Milgrom
sourceLocator: Figure 1, author-manuscript p. 21 (PDF p. 23); argument p. 3; after Milgrom, Numbers, p. xviii
note: All 17 source elements are retained. A (Genesis 1–11) is an unmatched introductory element. The source gives B4′ (Numbers) and B4″ (Deuteronomy) on the returning side, so B4 is a three-element group, not two invented mirror pairs. B8 (Exodus 33) is the proposed center. Full chapters and books are expanded mechanically to first and last numbered verses as reading context; those endpoint verses are not finer boundaries claimed by Pitkänen. Leviticus 1–Numbers 10:10 is split into two book-specific anchors without omitting intervening chapters. This is Pitkänen’s published adaptation of Milgrom, not an independent transcription of Milgrom’s original diagram. Complete source outline. Reading alignment: verified; 0 of 17 elements currently lack a verified complete reading-edition mapping. Unmapped source coordinates never enter reader discovery.
